welcome.title: Welcome to Jedro+
welcome.body: In one minute we'll show you where everything is. You can replay this guide any time from the profile menu at the top right.

newAppointment.title: New appointment
newAppointment.body: The fastest way to book: pick a client, a service and a time. You can add a new client on the spot.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.body: Your day, week or month in one place. Click an empty slot and a new appointment opens at that day and time.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.body: Every appointment with search and filters. This is also where you mark appointments as completed.

clients.title: Clients
clients.body: Your client base with visit history and contact details.

services.title: Services
services.body: What you offer, how long it takes and what it costs. Appointment length and price come from here.

staff.title: Staff
staff.body: The people who perform services and their schedules. Invite colleagues into the app with the code in Settings → General.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.body: Automatic messages to clients before and after appointments. Fewer no-shows, no manual work.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Company details, working hours, team, plans and add-ons.

gettingStarted.title: Your first steps
gettingStarted.body: This list walks you through getting started. Each step ticks itself off when you've done it.

userMenu.title: Guide and language
userMenu.body: Replay this guide or change the app language here.

grid.title: Click an empty slot
grid.body: A new appointment opens at that day and time. Hatched areas are outside your working hours.

newAppointment.title: Or use the button
newAppointment.body: You can also start a new appointment here, at the next free time.

views.title: Day, week or month
views.body: Pick the view that suits you best.

filters.title: Filters
filters.body: Show only selected staff or services when the calendar gets busy.
